description: Shaving the edge of paper or a plate to a feather so a join does not show as a ridge. The blade is first drawn along the work to raise a burr, then held nearly flat against a hard surface; a well-pared straight edge gives off a long continuous shaving, and the correct angle comes only with practice.
name: paring paper

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1901), Chapter III, p.53. Internet Archive.
